tb_exponential_background — 2D typed op

• 数据种类:video → video

• 调用:fullseye.apply(img, "tb_exponential_background", a=0.5, b=0.5)(2-D 的模型是一张图 + 两个标量旋钮 a,b∈[0,1])

用法

逐帧递归背景 `bg ← (1−α)·bg + α·frame → (T, H, W)（video`）。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

Typed bridge of the videostream op `exponential_background into the 2-D evolution registry: the same implementation, called under the op(v, a, b) convention. a drives alpha (default 0.05); b` is unused.
